description: Two short made-up quests for the quest ledger's tests. Not the garage's tale.

lines.text: Oh! Hello, little one. I'm Spud. Have you seen a shiny button anywhere?
My lucky button rolled away near the big rock. I think it is over there.
I'm so hungry I could eat a whole apple. Maybe two!
Thank you! That was the best apple ever.
It gets cold here at night. A warm fire would be lovely.

keepsakes.name: Spud's lucky button
keepsakes.description: A shiny brass button. It still feels lucky.

quests.title: The lost button
quests.summary: Spud has lost a lucky button. Help find it.

steps.journal: Say hello to Spud by the camp.
Look for the button by the big rock.
Spud is hungry. Bring Spud an apple.
Light the campfire so Spud stays warm tonight.

beats.title: A lucky button
beats.text: Spud gives you the lucky button to keep.

quests.title: The high place
quests.summary: Climb to the top of the island.

steps.journal: Find a Fractal.
Ask the Gubble to make a little light.
Spend three Fractals at the camp.
Reach the top of the island.

beats.title: The top
beats.text: You can see the whole island from here.
